_comment: atelier mutation testing config. See skills/atelier/references/workflow.md (Mutation testing).
_packageManager_comment: Stryker doesn't fully understand Bun yet; tell it npm so it doesn't probe for yarn/pnpm lockfiles.
_commandRunner_comment: The command runs once per mutant, so its cost is the whole run's. --bail stops at the first failing test, which is all a kill needs, and only the core's tests run because mutants live only there. A core with no test fails the dry run instead of passing.
_mutate_comment: Core only: src/domain + src/use-cases. Test files have no logic to mutate; ports/ files are type-only (zero mutable code).
_concurrency_comment: No concurrency key: Stryker's default is every core above 4 less one, else all of them (4 on a 4-core CI runner).
_reporters_comment: json feeds scripts/check-mutation-score.ts, which holds every file to thresholds.break: Stryker's own break judges the whole run's score.
_ignorePatterns_comment: Skip non-source dirs from the sandbox copy. .claude/ may contain a symlink Stryker cannot copy (ENOTSUP); the rest are pure noise. The file globs are anchored with a leading slash: gitignore semantics make a bare *.json match at every depth, which dropped a test's src/**/fixtures/*.json from the sandbox and failed the dry run.
